description: Calls and contract details the products need that the Ever Platform API contract does not carry yet. Each entry is answered by the mock platform and documented in the outbound-call table as pending upstream; it moves into contracts/openapi/ever-platform.v1.yaml when the platform contract publishes it. Request schemas here are closed and follow the outbound-call table.

instanceMirrorApps.why: app_sync is consented per tenant link and a batch may act for several, so Ever Platform's gate is any_link: it reads Ever-Link-Id when it is sent (that link must have app_sync; a value that is not a tenant link id answers 422 at #Ever-Link-Id) and otherwise needs app_sync on at least one active link; the pinned operation does not declare the header yet, so without this the client could not send it

parameters.name: Ever-Link-Id
parameters.description: The tenant link the batch is sent for. Optional: when named, `app_sync` must be enabled for that link; without it, for at least one active link of the installation. Each operation's own link is checked either way.

instanceListMirroredApps.why: the same any_link gate as the push: Ever-Link-Id is read when it is sent, and the pinned operation does not declare it yet

parameters.name: Ever-Link-Id
parameters.description: The tenant link the read is made for. Optional: when named, `app_sync` must be enabled for that link; without it, for at least one active link of the installation.

instanceReportInstallStatus.why: marketplace_installs is consented per tenant link, so Ever Platform refuses an installation's install status report without Ever-Link-Id (422 validation_failed at #Ever-Link-Id); the pinned operation does not declare the header yet

parameters.name: Ever-Link-Id
parameters.description: The tenant link the install acts for. Required: without it Ever Platform answers `422 validation_failed` at `#Ever-Link-Id`.
